# Aura — Design System

## Design Philosophy

Editorial luxury meets cinematic warmth. The design evokes the ambiance of a Michelin-starred restaurant — intimate, sophisticated, and meticulously crafted. Every element serves the dining narrative.

## Color Palette

- **Primary (Amber)**: #f59e0b — Warmth, appetite, golden hour
- **Rose Accent**: #f43f5e — Passion, intimacy
- **Ink Backgrounds**: #0c0a09 to #1c1917 — Depth and warmth
- **Warm Grays**: #44403c to #a8a29e — Natural sophistication

## Typography

- **Display**: Space Grotesk (700, 600) — Modern elegance
- **Body**: Inter (400, 300) — Clean readability
- **Scale**: Fluid type scale with generous letter-spacing

## Motion System

- **Hero**: Ambient particle movement, slow reveals
- **Scroll**: Section reveals with spring physics
- **Menu**: Tab transitions with AnimatePresence
- **Gallery**: Hover zoom, lightbox transitions

## Inspiration

- Michelin-starred restaurant websites
- Nobu, The River Cafe
- High-end hospitality brands
- Editorial food photography layouts
